proposition: Death years disagree by one in the papers: Bāysunghur d. 837/1433 in the dissertation (pdf 54 and 177) and Sensorium, but 1434 in New Brethren and 837/1434 in Grammatology; Qāsim-i Anvār d. 837/1433 in the dissertation and 1434 in the Occult Court. The Hijri year 837 began in August 1433, so both look like conversion differences, not disagreement about the year.
